'''Black_wraith Ralltiir Ops''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Black_wraith]]
* '''Published:''' 2 March 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS5]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|SE-D-ralltiiroperations.gif|label=Ralltiir Operations}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|Sudden Impact (V) (Virtual Set 5)|VS5O-47-Sudden_Impact.png|label=Sudden Impact (V)}}
* '''Strategy:''' Ralltiir Operations
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS5 ROps Black wraith DS 2004 GPN.txt |Download]] (omits Sudden Impact (V), Imperial Domination (V), Tarkin (V), Image Of The Dark Lord (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Introduction ==

White armor, Killing, and Immunity is all they know.

== Defensive Shields ==

These cards were posted as Defensive Shields outside the deck.

* 1x {{CardLink|Come Here You Big Coward (Dark)|Ref3-D-comehereyoubigcoward.gif|label=Come Here You Big Coward}}
* 1x {{CardLink|Death Star Sentry (V) (Virtual Set 2)|VS2O-29-Death_Star_Sentry.png|label=Death Star Sentry (V)}}
* 1x {{CardLink|There Is No Try (Dark)|Ref3-D-thereisnotry.gif|label=There Is No Try}}

Posted under Sudden Impact: Come Here You Big Coward, Death Star Sentry (V), There Is No Try, '+2 others' (unnamed).

== Notes ==

* Posted 'Sudden impact' (unmarked) dested Sudden Impact (V) (Virtual Set 5), the Dark Starting Effect that holds 5 Defensive Shields; the printed Dagobah card is an asteroid Effect and does not fit the five cards posted under it.
* 'First Strike or Secret plans' (Starting) and 'Secret plans or First strike' (Effects) are one card each: First Strike starts and Secret Plans is in Effects. Secret Plans dested the Special Edition Effect.
* Original-era (V): Death Star Sentry (V) (Virtual Set 2, shield); Imperial Domination (V), Tarkin (V) x2 and Image Of The Dark Lord (V) x2 (Virtual Set 4). The draft had dropped the (V) on Image Of The Dark Lord.
* Posted 'Vader’s saber' dested Vader's Lightsaber (Premiere); '“ Prefects office' (ditto of '<>Spaceport') Spaceport Prefect's Office; 'Elite stormtrooper' Elite Squadron Stormtrooper; 'Reactor term' Reactor Terminal.

== Strategy ==

First off, you I start by playing the effect, objective, ect. (of couse). First turn, pull the forest, drop any sites or unique characters (except wallen), hopefully you get a masterful move and/or trooper assault. Second turn, pull second site, hopefully you’ve got expand the empire by now (to play on the forest). Next turns, play holotable and play a presence on it (un honorable force drain bonus, plus more force),  get flip hopefully by turn four, reduce their drains while adding to your attrition, vader and mara with their sabers add to force drains, if they try to bother you trooper assault boost power (no need to worry about the immunity part, since their already immune). Asking why 2 docking bays? Well here’s the answer, so if you puny opponent, for example, hides on Tatooine playing a profit deck, bam you can get to them and pound their @$$!!!!........well not exactly literally:)

* the cape must come out I know, its not doing any thing, but my mind is kind of blank on what to replace it with.

***Edit***

no this is not a classic deck, i just dont own the good one.
